metadata.title: Two Degrees: eight five-stage demonstration journeys
metadata.source: Synthetic teaching data. All operators, companies and assets are fictional.
metadata.threshold_note: Chilled stages: 0 and 4 °C orange; 0 < temperature < 4 °C green; outside 0–4 °C red.
metadata.timing_note: Compressed demo timeline. Milking and cooling before its deadline are observational; warm milk there is expected.
metadata.event_note: Equipment faults and their recovery are explicit simulated events. Temperature and missing-reading incidents are detected from readings.
metadata.demo_instructions: Use Next incident, select a stage, then open Incidents. MILK-001 is clean; MILK-008 ends with unresolved transport alerts.

batches.route_name: Cedar Meadow farm to East Gate receiving hub

stages.name: Milking
stages.description: Fresh milk collected before cooling. Warm readings are expected in this illustrative stage.

stages.name: Initial cooling
stages.description: Milk temperature decreases progressively. Check the demo cooling target at stage completion.

cooling_target.description: Reach the demonstration target by 06:25; observe recovery through 06:29.

stages.name: Farm storage
stages.description: Cooled milk remains in the farm bulk tank before collection.

stages.name: Tanker loading
stages.description: The same batch is transferred through a closed hose into the assigned tanker.

stages.name: Transport
stages.description: Monitor the assigned tanker during the journey to the receiving dairy hub.
